text: ICU visiting hours are 4 to 6 PM. Only two visitors are allowed at the bedside at a time.
General ward visiting hours are 10 AM to 12 noon and 5 PM to 7 PM. Children under 12 are not allowed in the isolation ward.
Staff must clean their hands before touching a patient, before any clean procedure, after exposure to body fluids, after touching a patient, and after touching the patient's surroundings.
When hands are visibly dirty, wash them with soap and water for at least 40 seconds. Otherwise use an alcohol-based hand rub for at least 20 seconds.
Discharge planning starts on the day of admission. The nurse in charge confirms the expected discharge date with the treating team.

On the day of discharge the billing desk prepares the final bill and the pharmacy issues take-home medicines with written instructions. A patient who leaves against medical advice must sign a declaration form.
Follow-up appointments are booked before the patient leaves the ward.

To request a repair, staff submit a maintenance request form to the biomedical engineering department. Breakdowns of life-support equipment are reported by phone to the biomedical on-call desk immediately.
Faulty equipment must be tagged out of service and must not be used until the biomedical team completes a safety inspection.
If there is a fire, rescue people in danger, raise the alarm, contain the fire by closing doors, and extinguish it only if it is safe. Do not use lifts; use the nearest staircase.
Fire drills are held every six months in each department. Assembly points are marked on the ground floor.
Used needles and blades go into the puncture-proof sharps container at the point of use. Never recap or bend needles.
Sharps containers are sealed when three quarters full and collected by housekeeping every evening.
Nursing handover takes place at 7 AM, 2 PM and 9 PM. The outgoing nurse reviews each patient with the incoming nurse at the bedside.
Check two identifiers, the full name and the date of birth, against the wristband before giving any treatment or taking a sample.
